Committee: Agriculture and Forestry
Sponsor: Bedsole
Analyst: Bryan Young
Date: 04/13/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 551 as introduced could increase receipts to the State General Fund and municipal general funds from fines; increase receipts to the State General Fund, county general funds, municipal general funds, and other funds to which court costs are deposited; and could increase the obligations of the State General Fund, district attorneys, and local jails by an undetermined amount dependent upon the number of persons charged with and convicted of the offenses provided by this bill and the penalties imposed.
Danny Crawford, Chair
Agriculture and Forestry

Committee: Governmental Affairs
Sponsor: Ingram
Analyst: Vee Mosely
Date: 03/04/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 165 as passed the House of Representatives could reduce receipts to the State General Fund and the Secretary of State Entity Fund by $17.50 and $7.50, respectively, for each certificate of existence fee the Secretary of State elects to waive.
According to Secretary of State, the average annual distributions from these fees are estimated to be $265,000 to the State General Fund and $114,000 to the Secretary of State Entity Fund.
Jimmy Holley, Chairperson
Governmental Affairs
